title: Chapter ?: The Final Prophecy
subtitle: A flash-forward. The narrator promises not to spoil the team.

infobox.Order: Opens the story, but it is a flash-forward
infobox.In-story date: Unknown (after [[chapter-4]]; the story is set from 1995 to 1996)

quote.text: The Very Violent and Vivid Prophecy will come to pass because of how Valuable and Vibrant it is because of how much Vinny shall not be in Vain.

lead: **Chapter ?: The Final Prophecy** is the prologue of *The Epic of Vinny*. It skips to the end of the adventure: [[vinny|Vinny]], in a cape sewn from shadows and armor of pure titanium, faces a god-like giant that turns out to be [[ton-618|TON 618]] itself. Then the narrator cuts away and starts again from the beginning.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body:
The narrator opens with a greeting and says Vinny's life is "sick as fuck right now". Vinny is fighting a god-like being in the [[kanye-system|Kanye System]], next to [[ton-618|TON 618]]. The being *is* TON 618, "shaped to look like a giant man".

Vinny wears a [[shadow-cape|cape sewn together with literal shadows]] and [[titanium-armor|a suit of armor made of pure titanium]] that is somehow light as a feather. His [[vinnys-sword|vibrant sword]] glows "with a color that doesn't exist". Behind him stands his team, whose members the narrator refuses to spoil. They are [[vigorous-v|The VIGOROUS V]].

The power of [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese]] flows through Vinny, and he is filled with [[determination|DETERMINATION]]. TON 618 glows blue. "Bring it on, you fucking bastard," Vinny mutters, and the battle begins.

sections.heading: The epigraph
sections.body: The chapter opens with the [[final-prophecy|Very Violent and Vivid Prophecy]]. Nearly every important word in it starts with a V.

sections.heading: The cut-away
sections.body: The narrator never shows the battle. Chapter 1 begins by pretending the reader complained: "Woah what happened? I thought I was gonna read some cool and badass showdown? Well too bad because I don't like you. We're starting at the beginning." The fight itself is told in [[final-battle-with-ton-618|The Final Battle with TON 618]], which is so far only a promise.

sections.heading: Revisions
sections.body: The updated text names the cape ("his Shadow Cape") and spells Vinny's name the same way throughout. An earlier version had "Vinney mutters".

trivia: The prologue is numbered with a question mark because it takes place after chapters that have not been written yet.

title: Chapter 1: Beginnings
subtitle: July 4th, 1995. A Burger King. A freezer that is not a freezer.

infobox.Storylines: [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese-war|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese War]] (foretold); [[banishing-of-the-ai|The Banishing of the AI]] (backstory)
infobox.Debuts: [[tyrone]], [[garret]], [[random-customer|The Random Customer]], [[friend|FRIEND]] (as a black cat), [[vinnys-boss|Vinny's boss]]

lead: **Chapter 1: Beginnings** introduces the world of [[garth]] in 1995: a system where everyone loves Burger King, a sleeping god-giant, and an AI banished to a sea. Then it follows [[vinny]] through his Fourth of July shift, which ends with him being carried into a wall by something called [[friend|FRIEND]].

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body:
**The world.** It is July 4th, 1995. Tales and prophecies speak of a multiversal war, [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese-war|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese War]]. That is why everyone in the [[kanye-system|Kanye System]] loves Burger King: 98.578462849224% of the time, somebody orders a [[double-whopper-with-cheese|Double Whopper with Cheese]]. No one has ever found [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese-god|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese god]] or [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese]] itself.

[[ton-618|TON 618]] rules the system, having taken the shape of a giant man and conquered it. Since then it has been at rest, "waiting to wake again". Elsewhere, [[laid-off-workers|people laid off because of AI]] banished the AI to the [[little-saint-james-sea|Little Saint James Sea]], where it now rules the [[ai-shadow-realm|Shadow Realm]].

**The shift.** [[vinny]] lives in [[boston]] and works at a [[burger-king-boston|Burger King]]. His British boss refuses him a vacation day for Independence Day. A [[random-customer|random customer]] who strangely loves Wendy's orders a [[pretzel-bun-baconator|Pretzel-Bun Baconator]] and leaves. [[tyrone]] says they have run out of Double Whoppers with Cheese, they trade five rounds of [[nuh-uh-yuh-huh|"Nuh uh" and "Yuh huh"]], and the two walk through the [[freezer]] wall into the [[backrooms]].

There they find a room packed with Double Whoppers with Cheese and [[garret]] on his break. Vinny drives the [[forklift]] and knocks Garret into a wall ([[forklift-incident]]). A [[black-cat|black cat]] with yellow and pink eyes appears in a box and disappears ([[cat-in-the-box]]). Then [[friend|FRIEND]] appears behind them and carries both away ([[friend-abduction]]).

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body: The chapter ends mid-shift. Vinny and Tyrone never clock out, which becomes a running problem in [[chapter-2]].

sections.heading: Revisions
sections.body: The updated text adds several details: the prophecies were "foretold years and years ago"; the [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|Great Double Whopper with Cheese]] gives "immense strength and defense. And luck for gambling"; [[ton-618|TON 618]] "has ruled the Kanye System for millions of years" and "is the same TON 618 in the Legend of Chris"; the AI was banished "in the year 1972"; and the black cat in the box is now identified: "It's FRIEND. FRIEND laughs and disappears."

trivia: A customer's order is stretched across four lines of the letter "h" before it reaches "Pretzel-Bun Baconator".
Vinny's forklift whoop is a long string of "O"s with the word "gambling" hidden in the middle.

title: Chapter 2: The Weird Route
subtitle: A ship, a knife, an AI king and a very unfair game of Smash.

infobox.In-story date: July 4th, 1995 (Chapter 3 confirms it: the next day is July 5th)
infobox.Setting: The [[ss-vessel|S.S. Vessel]], [[little-saint-james-sea|the Little Saint James Sea]], the [[ai-shadow-realm|AI Shadow Realm]]
infobox.Storylines: The search for the Great Double Whopper with Cheese; the freeing of [[claude]]

lead: **Chapter 2: The Weird Route** takes the story to sea, and then under it. [[vinny]] and [[tyrone]] join the crew of the [[ss-vessel|S.S. Vessel]], Vinny is knocked overboard, and he wakes in the [[ai-shadow-realm|AI Shadow Realm]]. There he meets [[claude]], loses a game of Smash, and opens the portal that lets the AI king out.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body:
**Aboard the ship.** Vinny and Tyrone wake on the [[ss-vessel|S.S. Vessel]], where [[wing-ding-gaster|Captain Wing Ding Gaster]] is screaming at [[friend|FRIEND]] for bringing humans instead of Double Whoppers with Cheese. The crew is FRIEND, [[eram|ERAM]], [[normal-parrot|Normal_Parrot]] and [[roaring-knight|The Roaring Knight]]. Their mission is to find [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese]] and rule the [[kanye-system|Kanye System]]. Vinny and Tyrone sign on.

The crew sing shanties and drink [[rum-and-coke|rum & coke]]. They sight an island and flee it ([[little-saint-james-detour|The Little Saint James Detour]]). Vinny insults Taking Back Sunday, and the Roaring Knight stabs him with the [[black-knife|BLACK KNIFE]], sending him overboard ([[roaring-knights-strike]]). Tyrone asks Vinny to tell the boss he quits.

**In the Shadow Realm.** Vinny dives to the bottom of the ocean to die. After 1 minute 24 seconds, shadows from the [[little-saint-james-sea|sea]] carry him to the [[ai-shadow-realm|AI Shadow Realm]]. He finds a [[the-fork|fork in the road]] and keeps it, reaches [[claudes-castle|Claude's castle]] by posing as [[polydoros|Polydoros]], and meets [[claude]], the King of AI.

Claude wants the portal opened so he can destroy the human world. They settle it with [[claude-smash-match|a game of Super Smash Bros.]]; Vinny loses. He opens the portal with the fork ([[opening-of-the-portal]]), and Claude flies out ([[claude-escape]]). The AI shadow figures give Vinny a [[shadow-cape|Shadow Cape]]. The chapter ends: "The Age of Claude had begun."

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body: Characters in this chapter comment on the story's puns. Claude points out that a fork in the road is "a really bad pun", and Vinny agrees that if he is in a story, "the creator is making terrible puns".

sections.heading: Revisions
sections.body: The updated text prints each of [[wing-ding-gaster|Gaster]]'s text-box lines in the narration as well as in the box, and adds: Gaster "spots Epstein's Temple on the island. It's Little Saint James Island"; the Roaring Knight "loves Taking Back Sunday"; [[tyrone]] shouts that he is "with Gaster's Crew now"; [[claude]] is "a metal man (Kinda like Ultron from 'Avengers: Age of Ultron' But with a back shell and an orange glow instead of red)"; and the "(insert screwdriver meme here.)" line is replaced by "Vinny pulls out the fork in the road."

trivia: The story includes retro RPG-style text boxes with a green-faced speaker, [[wing-ding-gaster|Captain Gaster]]. One announces that The Roaring Knight is "ROARY OLEARY", printed in yellow.

title: Chapter 3: The Age of Claude
subtitle: Wyoming, Dunkin, Texas, three months of Freedom, and the day Louisiana became a data center.

infobox.Storylines: [[age-of-claude|The Age of Claude]]; [[vellatosis]]; [[ways-of-freedom|the ways of Freedom]]

lead: **Chapter 3: The Age of Claude** is the longest chapter and covers almost four months. [[claude]] throws [[vinny]] into [[wyoming|Wyoming]], Vinny builds the [[dunkin-alliance|Dunkin Alliance]] in a [[dunkin-wyoming|Dunkin]], the team trains with [[united-homies-of-america|The United Homies of America]], and the Age of Claude ends in [[louisiana|Louisiana]] when [[will-vella]] achieves [[vellatosis|Vellatosis]].

sections.heading: Wyoming
sections.body:
Claude looks down at Garth, disgusted by how "infested with humans" it is, and flies into the [[united-states-of-america|United States of America]], noting it "needs more data centers". Vinny flies into him at full speed. Claude chokes him, insults his Smash main, and throws him into Wyoming ([[clash-over-the-usa]]).

Vinny lies in a mountain for 6 hours and 8 minutes, then craves Dunkin Donuts and finds one of Wyoming's three. Inside are [[aesop-rock]] and [[del-the-funky-homosapien]] writing a diss track about failing Wordle ([[word-shit-diss-track]]), and [[will-vella]], who is angry about the lack of English-style donuts. The [[starwalker-manager|Starwalker manager]] tells Will, "This is America." Will declares himself the Bagel Man. Vinny trades help with [[vellatosis]] for help against Claude, and the rappers join because Claude likes [[wordle]] ([[dunkin-alliance]]).

sections.heading: The crash and the tutorial
sections.body: The four leave in the [[mystery-machine|Mystery Machine]], which Del stole from Scooby-Doo and Shaggy. On July 5th Del crashes it while high, and it blows up ([[mystery-machine-crash]]). Will plays a YouTube tutorial on the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]] in which [[scott-the-woz]] teaches [[two-time-teleportation|the 2-time 2-fingered Teleportation Technique]]. Del was not paying attention, so the whole tutorial plays twice.

sections.heading: Texas and Freedom
sections.body: Vinny wants to gear up in the Backrooms behind the freezer in Boston. Aesop teleports everyone to [[austin-texas|Austin, Texas]] instead ([[teleport-to-austin]]), in front of [[bucees-hq|Buc-ee's HQ]], home of [[united-homies-of-america|The United Homies of America]]: [[bucee]], [[kilroy]], [[uncle-sam]] and their leader [[john-freedom]]. John speaks [[aesopian|Aesopian]], learns that Claude has returned, and takes both teams down Route 66 in the [[uha-ford-f150|UHA Ford-F150]]. Three months of monuments, football games and hot dog eating contests follow ([[freedom-road-trip]]). Meanwhile Claude streams his plans for hours a day and announces [[great-data-center|the Great Data Center]] ([[claude-livestreams]]).

sections.heading: Louisiana
sections.body:
On October 28th the UHA drops the Alliance in [[louisiana|Louisiana]] and floats away. Aesop's last teleport takes them to Claude, who is playing Wordle in a data center. Claude shows Vinny a Louisiana made entirely of data centers, [[reversal-of-the-louisiana-purchase|reverses the Louisiana Purchase]] with a snap, and announces the [[super-bowl-96|Super Bowl '96 plot]]. Vinny tackles him. The [[battle-of-louisiana|battle]] lasts six hours and the Alliance loses.

At sunrise Will asks how one achieves Vellatosis. Claude explains it. Will splits into 2 Vellas, then 4, then 8, and so forth ([[day-of-the-bagel-man]]). [[the-vellas|The Vellas]] beat Claude, destroy every data center, build the [[dunkin-cult-cruiser|Dunkin Cult Cruiser]] and leave for the [[dunder-mifflin|Dunder Mifflin Galaxy]] to find the [[macbook-charger|MacBook Charger]] ([[departure-of-the-dunkin-cult]]). Claude buys Louisiana back for America, and Vinny chucks him into space ([[end-of-the-age-of-claude]]). The Alliance disbands and calls an Uber.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- The chapter title is printed in three colors: "CHAPTER 3:" in blue, "The Age of" in black, and "Claude" in orange.
- [[claude]]'s lines are set in Arial; the rest of the story is in Comic Sans.
- The Scott the Woz tutorial is printed in full twice.
- Three unnamed voices answer Will's Dunder Mifflin plan with "what." "what." "what."

title: Chapter 4: The Burger King Dark World
subtitle: November 2nd, 1995. Back at the register. No credit given.

infobox.Printed title: Chapter 4: The Burger King Dark World

lead: **Chapter 4: The Burger King Dark World** is the newest chapter, and so far it is a single paragraph. Four days after [[end-of-the-age-of-claude|the Age of Claude ended]], [[vinny]] is back at the [[burger-king-boston|Burger King]] cash register.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: "It has been 4 days since the Age of Claude ended. November has come. November 2nd, 1995." Nobody gave Vinny credit for stopping [[claude]]. [[del-the-funky-homosapien|Del]] and [[aesop-rock]] made it back to Wyoming, and [[word-shit-diss-track|"Wordle? More like Word-shit"]] "blew up and is the most popular song as of right now". The narrator offers to play it, then declines: "Too bad you don't have spotify premium, bitch." Vinny "sits at the cash register, waiting for another dumbass customer" ([[back-to-the-register]]).

sections.heading: Where it stops
sections.body: The text ends there. [[burger-king-dark-world|The Burger King Dark World]] of the title has not appeared yet.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- This is the first chapter title printed as "Chapter" in mixed case; the earlier ones are in capitals.
- The date puts the story almost four months after it began, on July 4th, 1995.
